data.name: RenderFailure_Title
data.comment: Title of the question after WPF's render thread failed (graphics output reset, e.g. after sleep at a dock)

data.name: RenderFailure_Question
data.value:
Windows reset the graphics output – this happens after sleep with a dock or an external monitor – and FerretSharp could not draw its window for a moment.
You can usually keep working. If the window no longer draws correctly, restart FerretSharp: open tabs and pending changes are kept, and you are asked about uncommitted changes first, as when closing.
Restart FerretSharp now?

data.name: WebViewCrash_Again
data.value:
The display crashed again shortly after it was loaded anew. Your connections, workspaces and open transactions are still there.
Restart FerretSharp? You are asked about uncommitted changes first, as when closing.
“No” loads the display once more.

data.name: WebViewCrash_BrowserGone
data.value:
The display (the WebView2 browser) has ended and cannot be loaded again.
Restart FerretSharp? You are asked about uncommitted changes first, as when closing.

data.name: WebViewCrash_Close
data.value:
The display has crashed, and there are uncommitted changes.
Yes: commit all and close No: roll back all and close Cancel: keep FerretSharp open

data.name: WebViewCrash_FinishFailed
data.value:
Not everything could be committed or rolled back.
Close anyway? Oracle rolls back what is not committed when the sessions end.

data.name: WebViewCrash_PendingOne
data.value:
The display has crashed. One change in the grid is not written yet and would be lost when it loads anew.
Yes: write it (no commit) and load anew No: discard it and load anew Cancel: leave the display as it is – closing FerretSharp asks about it

data.name: WebViewCrash_PendingOther
data.value:
The display has crashed. {0} changes in the grid are not written yet and would be lost when it loads anew.
Yes: write them (no commit) and load anew No: discard them and load anew Cancel: leave the display as it is – closing FerretSharp asks about the changes
data.comment: {0}: number of pending (not written) grid changes, more than one

data.name: WebViewCrash_FlushFailed
data.value:
Not all changes could be written.
Load the display anew anyway? What is not written is lost.
